EnforceCap.Name: Enforce spell point limit per effect
EnforceCap.Hint: Block activities that would spend more spell points on a single effect than the caster's proficiency bonus.

AutomateDrawbacks.Name: Automate numeric drawbacks
AutomateDrawbacks.Hint: Resolving Draining Casting, Painful Magic, Material Casting or Wild Magic on a chat card applies its effect (damage, save, gold, surge roll). Material Casting also blocks spending without enough gold.

DrawbackReminders.Name: Drawback rows on chat cards
DrawbackReminders.Hint: Sphere chat cards list the caster's drawbacks, each with Show and Resolve buttons.

AutoResolve.Name: Resolve numeric drawbacks automatically
AutoResolve.Hint: Resolve Draining Casting, Painful Magic, Material Casting and Wild Magic as soon as the card is posted, instead of waiting for the Resolve button.

HeaderBox.Name: Show spell points in the sheet header
HeaderBox.Hint: Show current spell points and sphere DC under the class line of the default dnd5e character sheet.
